rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 2004).
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 2015 as 'Kinda Blue'.
Introduced in United States by Newflora™ LLC in 2015 as 'Blue PomPom'.
rows.Bloom: Lavender. None to mild fragrance. Large, full (26-40 petals), globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
